evidenceSemantics.observedOutcome: A concrete check ran and emitted a pass or failure observation for one exact subject. A later failure does not erase an earlier observation.
evidenceSemantics.acceptedEvidence: A receipt was validated against its exact candidate, tree, deployment, and authority rules. Accepted stage evidence is monotone within an evidence bundle.
evidenceSemantics.overallAcceptance: The bundle is accepted only when every required stage, five distinct assurance principals, evidence-before-approval chronology, and the final production approval are accepted. A failed bundle may retain earlier accepted stage evidence without authorizing production or release.

operations.semantics: Projects a coherent generation/revision snapshot, authenticated operator identity, pending operations, and backend-observed terminal evidence while explicitly marking absent snapshots stale.
Atomically reserves a bounded operation identity before network dispatch and submits an authenticated, revision-bound request.
Uses the authenticated identity/revision path for stop while preserving server-side authority and terminality.

invariants: The browser is never the runtime authority and never declares success from a local acknowledgement.
Every mutation binds session, connection generation, runtime generation, displayed revision, snapshot digest, operation id, semantic digest, target, action, and reason.
An operation id is reserved before the first await that can dispatch transport work.
Concurrent duplicate submissions share one in-flight promise; conflicting semantics fail closed.
Accepted-but-timeout is indeterminate and must be recovered by operation id before retry.
The backend operation-id unique constraint is the final idempotency authority.
Same generation and revision with a different semantic digest is snapshot drift and is rejected.
Session identity cannot change during refresh; permission revision cannot regress or conceal permission drift.
Revoke, close, and stopped refresh paths remove local control authority even when transport cleanup fails.
Local recovery storage failure is visible but cannot wedge or authorize a control request.
Session, operation, audit-trace, snapshot, semantic, and outcome correlation identifiers are rendered only in deterministic redacted form; full values remain outside DOM text and attributes.
Control actions are disabled while the displayed view is stale or the session lacks the required permission.
Snapshot refresh failure marks the view stale; view inspection removes expired session permissions without erasing pending operations.
Backend observations preserve the admission audit identity; missing or changed traces never authorize terminal cleanup.
An absent V1 lookup remains indeterminate because delayed admission is still possible; final non-admission requires a separately versioned durable backend fence.
Recovery import preserves live dispatch promises and terminal history, rejects conflicts atomically, and bounds the combined pending inventory.
Independent accessibility and security reviewers are distinct from one another and from deployment, release, and security approval authorities.
Production approval cannot predate deployment, real-backend, independent review, or operational evidence; accepted bundles expose only domain-separated principal digests.

verification.accessibility: axe-core WCAG automated scan plus keyboard/focus assertions; manual screen-reader acceptance remains independent evidence

externalEvidenceGates: deployed backend operation-id uniqueness and durable lookup evidence
production monitoring, alert routing, and rollback exercise
independent assistive-technology and operator acceptance signature
five-principal review/approval separation and evidence-before-approval chronology
